entities.summary: Violet-Anne Wynne is an Irish independent politician who served as a Teachta Dála (TD) for the Clare constituency from 2020 until 2024. Elected as a Sinn Féin member, she resigned from the party and became an independent in February 2022 following a series of disputes with the local party organisation.
